page.overview:
Who is Maduin?

Similar though their names may be, Maduin and Madeen are actually quite different in the FF universe.|Mirage Manual entry}}

Maduin is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. He is a Grymoirian incarnation of Maduin originating from Final Fantasy VI. Maduin is one of four character representatives of that game, the other three being Terra, Edgar and Celes.

The player fights Maduin alongside Terra stacked with a Magitek Armor B in the Nonary Region at the beginning of Chapter 19, "The Other Nine Wood Hills".

Maduin himself does not join the player's party, but the player can obtain a duplicate of him for their own party by unlocking the Maduin transfiguration in a Titan's Mirage Board after acquiring a Maduin Memento. The player can acquire this memento by not losing a unit in the Sandstalker minigame when taking on intervention quest.
